family.description: This entry represents the mammalian BAF250a/b and its homologue osa from fruit flies [[cite:PUB00071661]]. They are part of the SWI/SNF-like ATP-dependent chromatin remodelling complex that regulates gene expression through regulating nucleosome remodelling. In humans there are two BAF250 isoforms, BAF250a/ARID1a and BAF250b/ARID1b. BAF250a/b may be E3 ubiquitin ligases that target histone H2B [[cite:PUB00071658]].
family.name: SWI/SNF-like complex subunit BAF250/Osa
